budget_hash_encoding: SHA256 of exact policy file bytes, including final LF
selection: Howard explicitly selects E2 in the direct 13 November work order; selection authorizes proposal preparation/publication only.
named_limit: Budget-fixed input caps: an escape-heavy artifact can stop the run early despite satisfying its artifact byte cap.

details.scope: Pin the existing budget_policy_sha256 binding and expose it on the preview receipt. Credential format, policy namespace, 1800-second validity, 8100-second deadline, HMAC and durable one-use logic unchanged.

independent_patch: On the same main base; no stacked PR or source commit created. Runtime composition requires all three reviewed budget patches; mixed versions refuse by policy hash.
unchanged: No credential, spend or model-call authority
live_blocks: Exact Claude review and applicable push/merge approvals
Green CI including Windows discovery and macOS durability
Operator disk/image/ledger evidence and exact spend/credential/run approval
preview_policy_compatibility: The retained preview policy permits at most five count/generation calls. E2 narrows both maxima to four through the exact pinned budget_policy_sha256; it does not expand or replace the credential policy. Existing dated policy remains byte-identical.
